title: Company AI Assistant - One place for answers
abstract: An AI assistant embedded in the company portal page that provides instant answers about policies, procedures, tools, and internal resources. It helps employees find information faster, reduces support requests, and improves productivity. E.g.:  how create expense report? where to find a technical document/download software? how change profile picture.
aiImpact: Employees spend less time searching across multiple systems or contacting support teams. The assistant provides quick, consistent answers, improves self service, accelerates onboarding, and reduces repetitive questions to HR, IT, Finance, and other support functions.
aiNovelty: Instead of searching through multiple portals, documents, and knowledge bases, employees can ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers with links to the correct systems, documents, or procedures.
aiFeasibility: The solution can be built using existing Copilot & SharePoint site technology combined with company knowledge sources. It can start with read only access to policies and documentation, then expand gradually to additional systems and capabilities.
aiFit: The solution improves employee productivity, simplifies access to company knowledge, supports digital transformation, and reduces operational overhead by making information available from a single entry point within the company portal.

title: DA Assistant: AI-Enabled Deal Analysis Automation
abstract: DA Assistant is an AI-enabled solution designed to automate and standardize Deal Analysis preparation by validating BOM data, connecting to product cost sources, applying controlled calculation logic, and creating a scalable foundation for an integrated Agent-of-Agents architecture supporting project analysis across finance, credit, RFPs, and contracts.
aiImpact: DA Assistant can reduce manual effort in Deal Analysis preparation by automating BOM validation, product cost retrieval, and direct material cost calculation. It improves reliability, traceability, and consistency by flagging missing data, abnormal cost values, and unresolved assumptions before pricing and approval discussions.
aiNovelty: The solution combines Copilot Studio, Dataverse, and Power Automate to create a finance-controlled AI assistant rather than a generic chatbot. It preserves the global costing format while applying structured logic, including Marketing Model matching and outlier-adjusted average costing across inventory organizations.
aiFeasibility: The project can start with a focused PoC using the existing Product Cost Master and standard Presales BOM format. The first MVP would validate BOM data, calculate direct material cost, and produce a finance-ready summary. External Power Platform support would accelerate setup, governance, and scalability.
aiFit: DA Assistant aligns with Ceragon’s need to improve Deal Analysis, RFP response, and project evaluation processes. It supports faster, more reliable commercial decisions and creates a scalable foundation for an Agent-of-Agents architecture integrating finance, credit, RFP, contract, and operational insights.

title: Ceragon Lightning File Manager
abstract: By treating internal desktop efficiency as a critical operational metric, we can eliminate dead time without compromising security. I have the technical capability and the security oversight required to incubate and execute this solution rapidly.
innImpact:
Business Impact & Proven ROI
 Massive Productivity Gains: This initiative scales a proven methodology. The recent file retrieval platform developed for the Sales Coordinator team successfully reduced invoice wait times from 5 minutes to 5 seconds.  
 Demonstrated Success: That single implementation eliminated approximately 492 hours of waiting time per quarter.  
 Global Scale: Expanding this efficiency from a targeted departmental solution to a global desktop utility—capitalizing on the momentum that secured the 2025 One Ceragon Award—will multiply these time savings across every department globally.
innNovelty:
Security & Technical Architecture
 Local-Only Execution: The tool will operate strictly on the local machine with no external cloud dependencies or telemetry, eliminating data exfiltration risks.
 InfoSec Governed: Architected and managed directly from an Information Security perspective to ensure the codebase and operational mechanics align with Ceragon’s highest security standards.
 Seamless Integration: Built to be lightweight, utilizing minimal system resources while outperforming native OS alternatives.
innFeasibility:
To develop and deploy a blazing-fast, custom file manager that operates completely locally on all corporate devices.
When paired with the recently implemented high-speed file searching tool, this will create a comprehensive, zero-latency file ecosystem. This combination will radically improve the daily user experience and instantly resolve existing complaints regarding system sluggishness.
innFit:
Problem Statement
Employees across Ceragon rely heavily on continuous file exploration, organization, and retrieval. Currently, the default Windows file manager suffers from sluggish performance and significant latency. These micro-delays compound throughout the day, creating chronic inefficiencies and generating frequent user experience complaints.

title: Stirling AI PDF as a Secure, Local Self-Hosted PDF Processing Platform for Ceragon
abstract: A Ceragon-controlled document intelligence and processing platform that reduces third-party exposure while improving employee productivity.oductivity.
aiImpact:
Ceragon employees routinely require PDF editing, merging, splitting, compression, conversion, OCR, redaction, document comparison and signing. Today, these requirements are fulfilled through a fragmented combination of desktop applications, external signing platforms and public PDF-processing websites.

Internal Defender telemetry demonstrates active use of at least 15 external PDF web applications. The observed activity includes 277 Smallpdf transactions across 49 users and 93 MB uploaded to Pdf2go. This creates a measurable risk that confidential documents may leave Ceragon’s controlled environment during routine business operations.

The proposed Ceragon Local AI Document Manager would provide one internally hosted and governed platform for PDF processing, private AI document assistance and signing workflows. Confidential files would remain within Ceragon-controlled infrastructure, significantly reducing third-party exposure and shadow-IT usage.

Expected outcomes include:

Reduction of confidential-document uploads to public PDF websites
Faster access to common PDF tools
Consolidation of fragmented PDF utilities
Private AI summarization, extraction, classification and comparison
Secure internal signing and approval workflows
Reduced dependency on external SaaS platforms
Centralized access control, auditing, retention and monitoring
Improved employee experience and document-processing efficiency

Success would be measured through external upload reduction, platform adoption, task completion time, signing cycle time, user satisfaction and security-policy compliance.
aiNovelty:
The proposed solution is not simply another PDF editor. It combines three capabilities into a unified, internally governed document platform:

A self-hosted PDF-processing foundation
A private AI document-intelligence layer
Identity-backed signing and approval workflows

Traditional PDF tools address individual operations, while public services require users to upload documents to third-party infrastructure. The Ceragon Local AI Document Manager would keep document processing and AI inference within Ceragon’s controlled environment.

The private AI layer would support authorized use cases such as:

Document summarization
Key-information extraction
Contract and policy comparison
Document classification
OCR-assisted analysis
Metadata extraction
Sensitive-information identification
Redaction recommendations
Natural-language document search
Signing-field recommendations

The platform’s main differentiator is the combination of broad PDF functionality, private AI, enterprise identity, auditability and internal data sovereignty through one Ceragon-managed user experience.
aiFeasibility:
The scope is realistic because the proposal builds on an actively maintained, open-source PDF-processing foundation rather than developing every PDF capability from scratch.

Stirling PDF already supports more than 60 PDF tools, locally hosted processing, automatic file deletion, Docker and Kubernetes deployment, SSO, user management, permission controls, API integration and batch processing.

A controlled 12-week proof of concept is proposed:

Phase 1: Security and Architecture Design, Weeks 1–2
Define approved use cases
Complete threat modeling
Establish data-classification restrictions
Review application dependencies and licenses
Design network segmentation
Define document retention and deletion requirements
Establish signing and audit requirements
Phase 2: Secure Deployment, Weeks 3–5
Deploy the platform in a segregated internal environment
Integrate Entra ID or corporate SSO
Implement role-based access
Configure TLS and certificate management
Restrict internet egress
Enable centralized security logging
Configure malware scanning and secure file deletion
Phase 3: AI and Workflow Extension, Weeks 6–8
Integrate an approved private language model
Implement document summarization and extraction
Introduce document comparison
Add policy-controlled AI prompts
Develop signing and approval workflows
Test API-based automation
Phase 4: Controlled Pilot, Weeks 9–12
Select pilot users from Legal, Finance, Sales Operations and IT
Measure user adoption and task-completion time
Perform vulnerability and penetration testing
Validate document deletion and access controls
Measure reduction in external PDF-service usage
Produce a production-readiness recommendation
Proposed Success Criteria
No unauthorized internet egress
No supported documents uploaded to external services
SSO and role-based access enforced
Document deletion technically verified
AI responses traceable to source documents
At least 70% pilot adoption
Positive user satisfaction
Measurable reduction in processing time
aiFit:
The proposal directly supports Ceragon’s security, operational-efficiency and employee-experience priorities.

Ceragon processes sensitive commercial, financial, customer, legal, technical and operational documents. Moving routine document operations into a Ceragon-controlled platform reduces the risk of confidential information being uploaded to public websites or processed by unmanaged third parties.

The solution supports Ceragon by:

Protecting intellectual property and confidential information
Reducing shadow IT and uncontrolled SaaS usage
Providing employees with a fast and trusted alternative
Standardizing document-processing workflows
Supporting data sovereignty and internal governance
Reducing fragmented software deployment and maintenance
Enabling secure automation through APIs
Establishing a reusable private-AI document capability
Improving signing and approval turnaround time

The solution would primarily improve internal employee operations, but the resulting protection of customer information, contracts and technical records would also strengthen Ceragon’s customer trust and security posture.
